title: Possible Communications within The Mall World?
content: I believe I've seen a few users here asking if they've seen someone they know or something similar to that. I think it would be interesting if those of us who are actively aware of The Mall Worlds existence could communicate with each other somehow. I have personally had good experiences with Lucid Dreaming techniques in the past and from my understanding sometimes you can just Manifest items with enough effort. Maybe if we chose a symbol or a maybe a small inconspicuous phrase that one could utter to random people without seeming threatning to see if we could make contact inside? I'm curious if anyone else has similar ideas or maybe something entirely different!
